saltstair-dock-101.name: Boatwright’s Slip
saltstair-dock-101.description: Cord and fittings hang beside the boatwright’s bench. The pier leads back to the crossing.

stations.name: Ferry frame
stations.detail: The ribs are pegged to a pair of trestles. A length of tarred cord follows the curve of the unfinished hull.

stations.name: Joiner’s bench
stations.detail: Chisels and a coil of hemp sit beside a half-fitted oarlock. The boatwright has marked the next cut in chalk.

saltstair-harvest-102.name: Wrack Strand
saltstair-harvest-102.description: Saltgrass and stranded fibre collect at the wrack line. Work the patch with a kama.

saltstair-plot-102.name: Wrack Strand Landing Plot
saltstair-plot-102.description: Survey stones mark a site for a Clan Landing. A clan holding this sector can establish and build here.

saltstair-mine-103.name: Splitstone Seam
saltstair-mine-103.description: A silver seam breaks through the limestone. A pickaxe can loosen the fittings ore.

saltstair-plot-103.name: Splitstone Seam Landing Plot
saltstair-plot-103.description: Survey stones mark a site for a Clan Landing. A clan holding this sector can establish and build here.

saltstair-fish-104.name: Needle Shoal
saltstair-fish-104.description: Small fish shelter in the rock pool at low tide. Carry a fishing pole to work the shoal.

saltstair-counter-105.name: Record House
saltstair-counter-105.description: The seal and blank orders belong at this counter. This is where the Stand-Down Order is forged.

stations.name: Writing counter
stations.detail: A brush rests beside the blank order. The cinnabar seal matches the stamp required by the garrison.

stations.name: Archive shelves
stations.detail: Scrolls are sorted by cord color. A salt-stained dispatch bears the same folded corner as the papers on the counter.

saltstair-houses-105.name: The Stair Houses
saltstair-houses-105.description: A stone stair climbs between nine salt-grey fishing homes to the shared cook house, past doorposts with family marks burned in or scraped away.

stations.name: Soup kettle
stations.detail: The broth smells of smoked fish and kelp. Nine bowls stand ready, including three with the family marks worn smooth.

stations.name: Salt cupboard
stations.detail: A stone keeps the salt crock shut against the damp. Each family has left a different little bowl on the shelf.

stations.name: Fish bench
stations.detail: The afternoon catch is laid out beside a mended net. A coil of clean twine waits for the next tear.

saltstair-harvest-106.name: Woundroot Bank
saltstair-harvest-106.description: Claret roots grow in the damp bank. Their sap supplies the Woundroot Vial.

saltstair-plot-106.name: Woundroot Bank Landing Plot
saltstair-plot-106.description: Survey stones mark a site for a Clan Landing. A clan holding this sector can establish and build here.

saltstair-fort-107.name: Unmoored Garrison
saltstair-fort-107.description: The outer gate takes the mark. Beyond it, the yard provides the setting for the Oath Guard and Bitter Tide encounters.
saltstair-fort-107.proposedQuest: 2 · First Footing / 3 · The Crossing War I

stations.name: Kit rack
stations.detail: Cloaks hang beneath rolled bedding. Salt has dried white on the hems of the patrol gear.

stations.name: Command table
stations.detail: Pebbles hold down a map of the tidal approaches. The dispatch beside the lantern is still tied.

saltstair-plot-108.name: Clan Landing Plot
saltstair-plot-108.description: Four cornerstones mark a founding plot. The ground stays empty until a clan raises its Landing.

saltstair-tracks-109.name: The Hound Trace
saltstair-tracks-109.description: The prints split around the juniper. A companion can follow the scent into cover.

saltstair-plot-109.name: The Hound Trace Landing Plot
saltstair-plot-109.description: Survey stones mark a site for a Clan Landing. A clan holding this sector can establish and build here.

saltstair-outcrop-110.name: The High Sill
saltstair-outcrop-110.description: A torn ward catches against the cleft rock. The sheltered hollow offers space for the companion trial.

brackwater-landing-111.name: Tide-cut Steps
brackwater-landing-111.description: Salt has whitened three cuts in the limestone. The lowest stays wet even at ebb tide.

brackwater-harvest-112.name: Inkseed Bed
brackwater-harvest-112.description: The seed heads stain the wet stone black. A split husk reveals the ink inside.

brackwater-counter-113.name: Relay House
brackwater-counter-113.description: A shuttered dispatch room overlooks the fields. Ink bowls and sealed paper wait on separate counters.
brackwater-counter-113.proposedQuest: 4 · The Crossing War II / 12 · The Uncounted

stations.name: Ink basin
stations.detail: The shallow bowls hold soot, brackish water and a residue of inkseed. A smooth stone fits the curve of the grinding bowl.

stations.name: Sealing counter
stations.detail: Two packets bear the same tide stamp. One names a passenger. The other leaves a space for a different name.

stations.name: Dispatch desk
stations.detail: The open register lists a second landing in smaller handwriting. The ink is still glossy.

brackwater-outcrop-114.name: Mirror Pool
brackwater-outcrop-114.description: A still pocket of water holds a second image of the cliff. Broken reflections gather at its rim.

brackwater-harvest-115.name: Pitchwood Drift
brackwater-harvest-115.description: The last tide wedged a resin-heavy spar among the rocks. Its cut end still beads with pitch.

brackwater-dock-116.name: Defector’s Quay
brackwater-dock-116.description: A narrow landing lies below the cliff. Someone has turned the mooring knot inward, out of sight from the watch.

brackwater-fish-117.name: Sounding Pool
brackwater-fish-117.description: A lead line hangs over the dark seam. Shells on the ledge mark the last safe sounding.

brackwater-counter-118.name: Watch Post
brackwater-counter-118.description: From the lookout, a signal cord runs down to the duty desk. Both floors overlook the defector’s route.

stations.name: Muster ledger
stations.detail: The watch changed hands before low water. A hooked mark beside the last name matches the cord at the quay.

stations.name: Signal reel
stations.detail: One pull calls a runner. Two call the boat. A length of reed thread has been spliced into the line.

brackwater-tracks-119.name: Courier’s Cache
brackwater-tracks-119.description: A packet fits behind the loose stone. The cord has the same double knot as the watch signal.

brackwater-tree-120.name: The Hollow Sentinel
brackwater-tree-120.description: A narrow opening leads into the oldest cedar on the rim. A broken ward hangs inside, high above the roots.

stations.name: Read the split ward
stations.detail: Three notches cut across the ward. Beneath them, a shallow groove climbs toward the sound of hanging wood.

stations.name: Sound the hanging clappers
stations.detail: The third clapper answers with a hollow note. Inside it is the missing half of the crown ward.
stations.locked: Three clappers hang on different cords. The order is carved into the ward below.

stations.name: Fit the ward into the living knot
stations.detail: The two cut edges meet. The branches settle, and through the crown you can see the trail running into Briarwood.
stations.locked: The living knot holds half a ward. Its missing piece is somewhere in the trunk below.

briarwood-tracks-121.name: Antlerwash Ford
briarwood-tracks-121.description: A set of claw prints ends in the shallows. Your companion catches the same scent on the far bank.

briarwood-counter-122.name: Witness Shrine
briarwood-counter-122.description: A strip of red cord marks the register room. The keeper sheltered a runner here before the ink had dried.

stations.name: Witness register
stations.detail: Two travelers used the same seal. Under the older entry the brush has left a second, finer line.

stations.name: Witness tablets
stations.detail: A cord has been cut from the third tablet. The two loose ends fit the tie on the runner’s packet.

briarwood-harvest-123.name: Keelroot Fall
briarwood-harvest-123.description: The storm tore a cedar loose from the cliff. Its bent heartwood follows the curve of a boat rib.

briarwood-counter-124.name: Chronicle Ruin
briarwood-counter-124.description: A stair survives inside the cracked record hall. The oldest witness copy lies in the cold archive above.

stations.name: Take the impression
stations.detail: The surviving lines form half a dispatch seal. The missing strokes should still be visible on the cold archive copy.

stations.name: Compare the archive folio
stations.detail: The impression fits the lower half of the seal. The original witness was recorded under a borrowed name.
stations.locked: The folio has only half a seal. The other impression is in the hall below.

stations.name: Read the stone fragment
stations.detail: The stone bears the same thin stroke that appears underneath the witness register.

briarwood-harvest-125.name: Thorn Brake
briarwood-harvest-125.description: Long briars grow around a fallen yew. A loose strand springs back into the shape of a knot.

briarwood-fort-126.name: Unmoored Leash Garrison
briarwood-fort-126.description: A narrow gate opens into the beast ward. The hoist above the feeding court still carries the tamer’s knot.

stations.name: Study the tether block
stations.detail: A keeper’s braid bends back under its own eye. The loose end once ran upward to the hoist gallery.

stations.name: Inspect the stall latches
stations.detail: Both latches open toward the central aisle. There are old claw marks beneath the nearer one.

stations.name: Trace the tamer’s knot
stations.detail: The return strand draws the ring open when the drum turns. This is the knot the Pact-Cutter Snare must undo.
stations.locked: The drum carries two crossed strands. Inspect the tether block downstairs to see which one returns.

briarwood-fish-127.name: Scentwater Shelf
briarwood-fish-127.description: A shed whisker clings to a flooded shelf. The small fish shelter on the side away from the den.

briarwood-outcrop-128.name: Sundered Tether
briarwood-outcrop-128.description: The bark has grown around a corroded iron ring. A length of old braid shows how the leash was spliced.

briarwood-tracks-129.name: Runner’s Hollow
briarwood-tracks-129.description: A strip of dispatch cloth is caught in a moss-lined hollow. The bootprints turn uphill toward the witness cedars.

briarwood-tracks-130.name: The Scent Stone
briarwood-tracks-130.description: The branch shadows from the Hollow Sentinel reach the first step. A scent mark on the stone draws your companion into the grove.

whitecrown-tracks-131.name: Ibex Scrape
whitecrown-tracks-131.description: Two deep hoof cuts share the ledge with a tuft of winter hair. The trail doubles back below the rim.

whitecrown-tracks-132.name: Courier’s Cleft
whitecrown-tracks-132.description: A strip of the defector’s wrapping catches on the lip of the cleft. Old pegs mark the climb from Saltstair.

whitecrown-outcrop-133.name: Emberglass Seam
whitecrown-outcrop-133.description: An amber vein passes through the white stone. A broken sliver holds a faint light even in shade.

whitecrown-counter-134.name: Pass Record House
whitecrown-counter-134.description: A counter fills the lee side of the pass house. The last sailing docket is kept in the loft.

stations.name: Read the split tally
stations.detail: The keeper punched two cuts through one passage tally. Only the older cut appears in the register at the door.

stations.name: Examine the travel tags
stations.detail: The last two tags hang on the same cord. One loop has been retied with blue thread.

stations.name: Match the sailing docket
stations.detail: The second cut fits the docket in the dispatch chest. Both names belonged to the same passenger.
stations.locked: Two dockets share this seal. Check the split tally at the counter below.

stations.name: Read the pigeonhole tags
stations.detail: Outbound dockets are stored by tide. A pale gap marks where this one was lifted from its slot.

whitecrown-fish-135.name: Icebell Shelf
whitecrown-fish-135.description: A bell-shaped ledge quiets the water beneath it. Tiny scales have washed onto the limestone.

whitecrown-counter-136.name: Ember Assay House
whitecrown-counter-136.description: Under the roof a single ember is sealed in a stone cup. The assay register records how the frost ward answered it.

stations.name: Lift the assay cap
stations.detail: A pinprick of amber holds its light beneath the cap. The ring around it matches the emberglass seam.

stations.name: Study the frost samples
stations.detail: Each sample has split in the same shape as the frost on the gatehouse basin.

whitecrown-tracks-137.name: Wind Collar
whitecrown-tracks-137.description: The wind hums through a hollow in the rock. A companion can hear the second call from the ridge.

whitecrown-fort-138.name: Rime Gatehouse
whitecrown-fort-138.description: A chain knocks in the lower hall. Above it, a frost-bound wheel holds the pass gate shut.

stations.name: Inspect the chain stop
stations.detail: Three links have left dark impressions in the stone stop. The middle impression is split down one side.

stations.name: Read the gate beam
stations.detail: The keeper marked the beam at every thaw. Only the last mark reaches the hanging chain.

stations.name: Trace the wheel chain
stations.detail: The split link seats in a narrow tooth. Above that tooth a line of frost climbs toward the lantern room.
stations.locked: Several links fit between the teeth. Inspect the chain stop in the hall below.

stations.name: Examine the frost basin
stations.detail: A fork in the frost lines up with the wheel tooth below. It marks the point where the keeper tested the Rime Lock.
stations.locked: Three cracks meet under the frost. Follow the split link through the wheel chamber first.

stations.name: Look through the shutters
stations.detail: From the highest shutter you can see the pale line of the Split Needle across the pass.

whitecrown-outcrop-139.name: Frost Witness
whitecrown-outcrop-139.description: A line of frost survives on the shaded face of the split stone. The same broken pattern appears at the gatehouse.

whitecrown-tracks-140.name: Last Dispatch Cairn
whitecrown-tracks-140.description: The descent to the High Sill begins beside a hollow cairn. A seal impression is still visible under its cap.

hushcrown-shrine-141.name: The Witness Bell
hushcrown-shrine-141.description: An old bell is cradled between two pale roots. The stone under it carries a second impression where no bell ever hung.

hushcrown-harvest-142.name: Windroot Bed
hushcrown-harvest-142.description: A streak of red runs under the silver bark. The remakers stamped this branching root on the older remedy pattern.

hushcrown-mine-143.name: The Silver Seam
hushcrown-mine-143.description: Silver flecks in a split slab leave a dark streak on the fingers. The field workshop keeps a sample with its second pattern.

hushcrown-counter-144.name: Remakers’ Field Workshop
hushcrown-counter-144.description: In the lower room a remaker kept the first pattern. Its partner hangs in the drying loft.

stations.name: Examine the remedy pattern
stations.detail: The clay holds an old Woundroot Vial impression. A narrow knot on the potter’s tally leads to a pattern kept upstairs.

stations.name: Look inside the storage jars
stations.detail: The black stain inside one jar matches the second mark in the remakers’ ledger.

stations.name: Match the two patterns
stations.detail: The older leaf records the Woundroot Vial. The Clouding Ink leaf has the same knotted tally. Two ward disks at the Twin-Ward Post carry these marks.
stations.locked: Two leaves fit this folio. Look for the matching tally knot on the provision counter below.

stations.name: Inspect the drying cords
stations.detail: The pale fibers still hold a fine dust of inkseed husk.

hushcrown-fish-145.name: Stillwater Shelf
hushcrown-fish-145.description: A narrow runnel fills a shelf among the roots. The water holds the reflection of a tree on the far ridge.

hushcrown-plot-146.name: Windfast Landing Plot
hushcrown-plot-146.description: Four stones and a cut cedar peg mark a sheltered shelf where a clan can raise a landing.

hushcrown-tracks-147.name: Keelroot Marker
hushcrown-tracks-147.description: The ascent from the Split Keel ends at a stone curled inside a root. Old ties lead uphill toward the post.

hushcrown-fort-148.name: Twin-Ward Post
hushcrown-fort-148.description: The lower watch room and upper ward loft each keep half of the post seal. The remakers’ two tools answer the two Holds here.

stations.name: Examine the lower ward disk
stations.detail: A forked red notch crosses the lower disk. Its other half is stamped into the case upstairs.

stations.name: Watch the cedar line
stations.detail: The cords on the ridge pull in the wind. The trees behind the post stand still.

stations.name: Read the paired ward case
stations.detail: The red fork fits the first seat, the dark fan the second. The post kept its two Holds in that order.
stations.locked: Two seats share an edge. Find the notch on the lower disk to read the order.

stations.name: Look over the ridge
stations.detail: Windfast Shelf lies below the windows. Beyond it, the high roof of the last garrison rises through the cedars.

hushcrown-tracks-149.name: Threefold Trace
hushcrown-tracks-149.description: Three narrow tracks converge on the last garrison. The last set of prints ends at an upright piece of bark.

hushcrown-fort-150.name: Hushcrown Garrison
hushcrown-fort-150.description: A broken seal in the vestibule, its witness in the oath gallery, and its crest in the command hall mark the three Holds of the Unmoored.

stations.name: Examine the split seal
stations.detail: The gate seal is broken across a three-part crest. Its lower edge has the shape of a folded wing.

stations.name: Study the gate cord
stations.detail: The keeper tied three knots in the indigo cord. Only the last knot is still drawn tight.

stations.name: Match the oath plaques
stations.detail: One plaque fits the broken wing. Its crest closes around an empty circle, the size of a command seal.
stations.locked: Several plaques carry a wing. Inspect the broken gate seal below to find the matching edge.

stations.name: Read the command seal
stations.detail: The circle completes the crest of the Unmoored leader. Through the shutters the three terraces of the last garrison lie perfectly still.
stations.locked: The seal has three impressions. Read the broken gate seal and its matching oath plaque first.

stations.name: Unfold the command banner
stations.detail: The indigo has faded everywhere except the fold that once covered the command crest.
